# NVDA closing price on 2026-08-25: research brief (information to 2026-08-04 only)

I could not find a verified closing price for the latest trading days (July 31, August 3 or August 4). Every page fetch failed at the proxy, including Yahoo Finance, so all figures below come from search snippets. Many results were dated after 2026-08-04. I left those out as instructed.

## 1. Resolution source
- The question resolves on the NVDA daily close on Yahoo Finance for 2026-08-25, a Tuesday and a normal trading day. I could not load the [Yahoo history page](https://finance.yahoo.com/quote/NVDA/history/), so I can't report the latest value it shows.
- The best price information I found (all unconfirmed):
  - 2026-07-27: NVDA fell about 4.9% to $196.66 as a chip selloff deepened. [Insider Finance](https://www.insiderfinance.io/news/nvidia-stock-slumps-as-chip-selloff-deepens)
  - 2026-07-30: it traded near $195.50 early in the session, up about 3%. [Invezz](https://invezz.com/news/2026/07/30/why-nvidia-stock-is-rebounding-around-3-after-big-tech-earnings/)
  - 2026-07-31: it closed up 3.46%, according to an auto-generated piece that gives no dollar close. [TradingKey](https://www.tradingkey.com/news/market-movers/262068195-market-movers-nvda-20260731)
  - Taken together, these suggest a close somewhere around $195 to $205 at the end of July. That range is my estimate, not a reported number.

## 2. Current status
- Nothing has happened that settles the question. The August 25 close comes the day before earnings, so the earnings result itself can't affect it. Run-up positioning ahead of the report can.

## 3. Recent news (newest first)
- 2026-08-02: The Motley Fool ran "Prediction: Nvidia Stock Will Skyrocket on Aug. 26". A snippet says NVDA was up only about 2% for 2026, against about 7% for the S&P 500. [Fool](https://www.fool.com/investing/2026/08/02/prediction-nvidia-stock-will-skyrocket-on-aug-26/)
  - That 2% may be measured at an earlier date. If it is current, it implies roughly $190, assuming the 2025 year-end close was about $186.5. That year-end figure is from my own memory and I have not verified it.
- 2026-07-30: Chip stocks rebounded after Microsoft's results. Strong Azure growth and unchanged capex plans revived hopes for AI infrastructure spending. Meta's results were softer. AMD rose about 13% and Intel about 12%. [Invezz](https://invezz.com/news/2026/07/30/why-nvidia-stock-is-rebounding-around-3-after-big-tech-earnings/)
- 2026-07-29: Nvidia set its fiscal Q2 2027 results call (quarter ended July 26) for Wednesday, August 26, at 5 p.m. ET. [NVIDIA IR](https://investor.nvidia.com/news/press-release-details/2026/NVIDIA-Sets-Conference-Call-for-Second-Quarter-Financial-Results/default.aspx)
- Late July 2026: CNBC analysis, via a secondary site, put Nvidia's loss at about $238 billion in one week during a broader chip selloff of more than $1 trillion. [eciks](https://eciks.org/17118-nvidia-stock-chip-sector-selloff)
- 2026-07-08: Bloomberg reported Nvidia had lost about $1 trillion of market value in under two months, taking its valuation to pre-AI-boom levels. Yahoo Finance dated the peak to May 14, with shares down about 16% since. [Bloomberg](https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2026-07-08/nvidia-s-1-trillion-slide-sends-valuation-to-pre-ai-boom-levels), [Yahoo](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/nvidia-1-trillion-slide-sends-084308296.html)
- 2026-07-01: Finbold cited a price near $199.87 at that time. [Finbold](https://finbold.com/ai-predicts-nvidia-stock-price-for-july-31-2026/)

## 4. Base rates
- **Recent range:** roughly $195 to $200 in July, after a slide of about 16% from the mid-May peak. Daily moves of 3% to 5% were common in late July.
- **Typical variation:** at an annualized volatility of about 40 to 50%, the 15 trading days from August 4 to 25 give a one-standard-deviation move of about ±10 to 12%. That is about ±$20 to $24 on a $200 base, so a 1-sigma band of roughly $178 to $222. This is my own calculation, not a sourced figure.
- **Pre-earnings pattern:** implied volatility usually rises into the report, but Aug 25 is before the release, so the earnings-day move itself is not part of the outcome.

## 5. Other forecasts
- Polymarket lists NVDA close ladders for August 2026, including an "NVDA close above ___ on August 25" market. [Polymarket](https://polymarket.com/event/nvda-above-in-august-2026)
  - I could not get prices on those markets that are clearly dated before August 4, so I'm reporting none.
- I found no Kalshi or Manifold markets for this.
- Finbold's AI-generated July forecast targeted about $200 for July 31. That's low quality. [Finbold](https://finbold.com/machine-learning-algorithm-sets-nvidia-stock-price-for-july-31-2026/)

## 6. Upcoming events before resolution
- **Mid-August:** US CPI and PPI inflation data. Hot inflation prints hit chip stocks earlier this year.
- **August 20-ish:** FOMC minutes, the Jackson Hole symposium (usually late August) and other macro news.
- **Through August:** reports from AI-related peers and the hyperscalers, plus any news on China and export controls or tariffs.
- **2026-08-26, after the close:** Nvidia's earnings. Positioning in the days before Aug 25 can move the stock.
